prompt: Which North Atlantic tropical storm, whose peak intensity remained at tropical storm level, caused the highest number of deaths last year?
answer: **Tropical Storm Barry** caused the highest number of deaths among 2025 North Atlantic storms that never intensified beyond tropical-storm strength. It peaked at **40 kt (about 46 mph)** and caused **eight direct deaths in Mexico**.
